nodes.name: bookmarks.yaml

nodes.name: custom.css
nodes.summary: Custom CSS styling for the Market Intelligence trading dashboard, implementing design tokens, color scheme, and layout for a dark-theme monitoring interface.
nodes.languageNotes: CSS uses CSS custom properties (variables) for design tokens, enabling consistent theming across the dashboard. Features a dark color palette optimized for market data visualization.

nodes.name: docker.yaml
nodes.summary: Docker service configuration template for homepage, with commented examples for connecting to Docker sockets or TCP endpoints.

nodes.name: index.html
nodes.summary: Main HTML entry point for the Market Intelligence monitoring homepage dashboard, providing a unified view of trading systems, research tools, and infrastructure services.

nodes.name: kubernetes.yaml
nodes.summary: Kubernetes service configuration stub for homepage deployment, with minimal placeholder configuration.

nodes.name: proxmox.yaml
nodes.summary: Proxmox hypervisor monitoring configuration for the homepage dashboard.

nodes.name: services.yaml
nodes.summary: Central service registry defining three categories (Trading, Research, Infrastructure) with 13+ services, including dashboards, signal flow, LLM chat, RSS readers, and uptime monitoring.

nodes.name: settings.yaml

nodes.name: widgets.yaml
